avoid_for: Formal enterprise, financial or B2B software, dark-mode products, or any premium/editorial context — the 8-bit single-font system and cream+black binary read toy-like and can't carry subtle or authoritative messaging.
best_for: E-commerce product pages for streetwear / skate / indie apparel brands that want a retro arcade-kiosk feel — compact cream product grids, pixel type, one orange marquee and one green buy button, Palace/Polar-adjacent.
name: FRANKY'S
palette_voice: A deliberately impoverished palette on a warm Arcade Cream (#f3e5df) canvas: Ink Black (#000000) for all text, borders, and checkerboard tiles, Pixel Gray (#e5e7eb) hairlines, Charcoal (#333333)/Carbon (#151515) for checkerboard depth, Marquee Orange (#faa21f) reserved for the top announcement bar only, and a single Buy Green (#128e44) for the filled Add-To-Cart button — the only two chromatic colors in the whole system; depth comes from a 1px inset cream line and the checkerboard, never soft shadows.
signature_moves: Black-and-white checkerboard (#f3e5df / #000000, ~48px tiles) as the hero product panel and brand pattern — never a functional UI surface
6px radius on all CTAs, tags, and toggles with a 1px inset cream highlight (rgb(243,229,223) 0 1px 0 0 inset) for the arcade-button bevel
Marquee sheen gradient band (orange → cream → orange) across the top — the only decorative chromatic surface on the page
Single-arcade-font weight jump (400 body → 700 titles/nav/footer) as the complete hierarchy system
Filled Buy Green Add-To-Cart button (6px radius, white uppercase 700 text) — the only green surface, reserved for purchase only

source.shadow: single inset highlight rgb(243,229,223) 0 1px 0 0 inset + flat #333333 contact shadow under hero cap

tagline: Retro arcade kiosk on a skate-shop counter.
typographic_voice: One 8-bit Arcade pixel font (subst. VT323 / Press Start 2P) sets every word on the site — headings, labels, prices, buttons, body, icons — with the 400-to-700 weight jump as the entire hierarchy tool; letter-spacing stays normal because the font's bitmap grid is the rhythm; all-caps-leaning, only 10-18px sizes, no second typeface, no decorative typography, no sans, no scripts.
